mapper.insert:
SELECT GRU.GRU_VISTA_SEQ.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO GRU.GRU_VISTA_TAB ( ID, SYSTEMACCOUNT, CURRENCY, XALFA, OPERATION, TIME_STAMP, TIME_STAMP_UPDATE, POM_ID, UTERRARIO, OLDTBAL, NEWTBAL, ADD_INFO, FILE_ID, FOC_STATUS, FOC_TS, FOC_TYPE, SVFE_LOAD_ID ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{systemAccount}, #{currency}, #{xalfa}, #{operation}, #{timeStamp}, #{timeStampUpdate}, #{pomId}, #{uterrario}, #{oldTBal}, #{newTBal}, #{addInfo}, #{fileId}, #{focStatus}, #{focTS}, #{focType}, #{svfeLoadId} )
mapper.select: SELECT ID, SYSTEMACCOUNT, CURRENCY, XALFA, OPERATION, TIME_STAMP, TIME_STAMP_UPDATE, POM_ID, UTERRARIO, OLDTBAL, NEWTBAL, ADD_INFO, FILE_ID, FOC_STATUS, FOC_TS, FOC_TYPE, SVFE_LOAD_ID FROM GRU.GRU_VISTA_TAB

SELECT ID, SYSTEMACCOUNT, CURRENCY, XALFA, OPERATION, TIME_STAMP, TIME_STAMP_UPDATE, POM_ID, UTERRARIO, OLDTBAL, NEWTBAL, ADD_INFO, FILE_ID, FOC_STATUS, FOC_TS, FOC_TYPE, SVFE_LOAD_ID FROM GRU.GRU_VISTA_TAB WHERE FOC_STATUS = 'WAIT' AND ( FOC_TYPE = 'IMMEDIATE' OR ( FOC_TYPE = 'INTIME' AND FOC_TS <= SYSDATE ) ) AND ROWNUM <= #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED

SELECT /*+ INDEX(GRU_VISTA_TAB IDX_GRU_VISTA_SVFE_LOAD_ID) */ ID, SYSTEMACCOUNT, CURRENCY, XALFA, OPERATION, TIME_STAMP, TIME_STAMP_UPDATE, POM_ID, UTERRARIO, OLDTBAL, NEWTBAL, ADD_INFO, FILE_ID, FOC_STATUS, FOC_TS, FOC_TYPE, SVFE_LOAD_ID FROM GRU.GRU_VISTA_TAB WHERE SVFE_LOAD_ID = #{svfeLoadId}
mapper.update: UPDATE GRU.GRU_VISTA_TAB v SET v.FOC_STATUS = 'WAIT', v.SVFE_LOAD_ID = 'None' WHERE v.FOC_STATUS = 'IN_PROCESS' AND GREATEST(v.TIME_STAMP, NVL(v.FOC_TS, v.TIME_STAMP)) < SYSDATE - INTERVAL '2' MINUTE AND ( v.SVFE_LOAD_ID IS NULL OR v.SVFE_LOAD_ID = 'None' OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ACC_APP_ADAPTER.APP_ADAPTER_TRANS t WHERE t.REQUEST_ID = v.SVFE_LOAD_ID AND t.STATUS IN ('CONSUMER_WAIT', 'CONSUMER_IN_PROCESS') ) )
